result_text:
I changed `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` so `all_files.zip` is built from the configured aspect names instead of fixed literals. I only compiled the `reports` module (`mvn -q -o -pl reports compile`, no errors). I did not run any tests or try a renamed aspect.

The export block that builds `all_files.zip` used to read `aspect_main.txt`, `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` and the rest by hard-coded name. Renaming an aspect made one of those reads fail, which skipped `all_files.zip` and `git-history.zip` (both are written in the same try block), leaving only a logged stack trace.

It now takes the main, test, generated, build and deployment, and other aspects in that order. For each one it gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName`, the same method that writes the loose text files, and uses that name both to read the file and as the zip entry name.

With the default configuration the entries and their order are the same as before. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, and `git-history.zip` is written when a `git-history.txt` exists.
